edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender into _transferFrom from transfer.
transfer uses msg.sender as the implicit sender.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for allowance checks.
approve writes the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
msg.sender is compared against owner and pair inside _checkTxLimit.
block.timestamp drives epoch reset via block.timestamp - lastKingChange > resetPeriod.
_reset stores block.timestamp in lastKingChange.
swapBack uses block.timestamp as router deadline.
Recipient of a large buy is written to the King state variable.
_checkTxLimit updates biggestBuy with the ETH value of the buy.
_checkTxLimit updates lastKingChange on crowning a new King.
_checkTxLimit calls _reset on epoch expiry and on King sell.
_checkTxLimit sets hasSold[sender] = true.
_checkTxLimit enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount.
_checkTxLimit consults isTxLimitExempt for sender and recipient.
_checkTxLimit compares sender and recipient against pair.
_checkTxLimit calls router.getAmountsIn to price the buy in ETH.
owner bypasses the transaction limit and wallet limit checks.
The attacker-influenced King address is the target of the ETH payout call.
marketingWallet is the target of the low-level ETH payout call.
swapBack performs an external low-level call sending ETH to marketingWallet.
swapBack performs an external low-level call sending ETH to the King while the swap guard is active.
swapBack calls router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens and addLiquidityETH.
swapBack reads swapThreshold-based token amounts tied to the contract balance state.
swapBack forwards liquidity tokens to autoLiquidityReceiver.
_transferFrom triggers swapBack when the contract balance exceeds swapThreshold.
recoverLosteth converts to a raw ETH transfer to msg.sender.
recoverLostTokens performs an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer.
recoverLosteth sends the contract ETH balance to the authorized caller msg.sender.
recoverLostTokens sends tokens to the authorized caller msg.sender.
_transferFrom invokes _checkTxLimit before moving balances.
_transferFrom calls takeFee for non-exempt transfers.
_transferFrom falls back to _basicTransfer during swap-and-liquify.
_transferFrom calls isWalletToWallet to block wallet-to-wallet transfers.
_transferFrom subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance.
takeFee adds feeAmount to the contract balance.
takeFee uses totalFee / totalFeeIfSelling to compute the fee.
transfer delegates to _transferFrom.
transferFrom delegating after allowance adjustment.
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from _allowances.
approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
approveMax calls approve with uint256(-1).
isWalletToWallet consults isFeeExempt for sender and recipient.
feedTheBeast moves the bot balance into the contract balance.
setFees writes liquidityFee.
setFees writes marketingFee.
setFees writes kingFee.
_reset sets King to marketingWallet.
_reset reads marketingWallet as the new King.
_reset sets biggestBuy = 0.
_reset writes lastKingChange.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets the initial King to msg.sender.
constructor instantiates the router.
constructor assigns _totalSupply to msg.sender.
transferOwnership reassigns the owner address.
authorize is guarded by authorization semantics used by the authorized modifier.
Owner checks inside _checkTxLimit mirror the onlyOwner privilege model.

recoverLosteth is restricted to authorized callers via msg.sender.
feedTheBeast is restricted to authorized callers via msg.sender.
epochReset exposes lastKingChange plus resetPeriod.

setSwapBackSettings writes swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
setSwapBackSettings writes swapThreshold.
setSwapThreshold writes swapThreshold.
setFeeReceivers writes marketingWallet.
setFeeReceivers writes autoLiquidityReceiver.

normalization_plan.reason: sender parameter belongs to _transferFrom and must be normalized into it.
recipient parameter belongs to _transferFrom and must be normalized into it.
amount parameter belongs to _transferFrom and must be normalized into it.
amountReceived is a temporary computed inside _transferFrom.
feeApplicable is a local computed only inside takeFee.
feeAmount is a local computed only inside takeFee.
tokensToLiquify is a local of swapBack derived from swapThreshold.
amountToLiquify is a local of swapBack.
amountToSwap is a local of swapBack.
amountETH is a local read of the contract balance inside swapBack.
amountETHKing is the local payout share computed in swapBack.
totalETHFee is the local fee denominator in swapBack.
holder parameter relates directly to the allowance/approve allowance handling.
spender parameter is the direct argument written by approve.
newLiquidityFee is the direct argument written by setFees.
bot parameter is the direct address drained by feedTheBeast.
botBalance local is read and zeroed inside feedTheBeast.
